package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    Object payload,
    Object value,
    Object dup,
    List<String> listOf,
    String nullFirst,
    String allNull,
    Object nestedAny,
    String plain
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (Object) map.get("payload"),
            (Object) map.get("value"),
            (Object) map.get("dup"),
            (List<String>) map.get("listOf"),
            (String) map.get("nullFirst"),
            (String) map.get("allNull"),
            (Object) map.get("nestedAny"),
            (String) map.get("plain")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("payload", payload);
        map.put("value", value);
        map.put("dup", dup);
        map.put("listOf", listOf);
        map.put("nullFirst", nullFirst);
        map.put("allNull", allNull);
        map.put("nestedAny", nestedAny);
        map.put("plain", plain);
        return map;
    }
}
